RHEA has therefore the mandate to select under the supervision of ESA, and via ESA’s Best Practices Processes, the services of eligible Resource and Platform Tier Providers for the next phase of the Network of Resources. The NoR portal (https://nor-discover.org) lists in an online directory all the onboarded providers together with their NoR service portfolio. ESA can sponsor or co-fund scientists and value adding users for eligible research, development and pre-commercial projects. The portal also provides users with links to each providers helpdesk and website. This intended tender is for the selection of Resource Tier and Platform Tier providers using cloud services with collocated Sentinel and non-Sentinel data. Resource Tier and Platform Tier providers wishing to contribute to the NoR service directory are invited to provide a proposal. Following the previous NoR Open Call, the tender process is made as simple as possible for interested service providers to respond to.
